:::{#exr-flat-point}

#### Differentiate a quadratic

A [flat point](#def-flat-point) of a [function](functions.qmd#def-function)
is where its [derivative](calculus-derivatives.qmd#def-derivative) is zero.
To see this,
take a simple function with a [minimum](algebra.qmd#def-minimum),
the quadratic $f(w) = w^2 - 4w + 7$, <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
whose [graph](functions.qmd#def-graph) is a [parabola](algebra.qmd#def-parabola).
The next exercises use it
to find where $f$ is flat
and to compare a [linear approximation](calculus.qmd#eq-linear-approx)
of a nearby [value](functions.qmd#def-value) with the exact value.

Differentiate $f$.

:::
